findings.claim: Ford Q3 2026 調升 EBIT 指引下緣至 $10.5–11bn
findings.excerpt: adjusted free cash flow of $2.1 billion • Company declares a third-quarter regular dividend of 15 cents per share • Company raises full-year adjusted EBIT guidance to $10 billion to $11 billion (from $8.5 billion to $10.5 billion) and adjusted free cash flow to $6.0 billion to $7.0 billion (from $5.0 billion to $6.0 billion) DEARBORN, Mich., July 28, 2026 – Ford
